out_of_hospital_midwife.kit_ordering: Certified nurse midwives and other out-of-hospital providers order newborn screening filter-paper cards and tubes from the State Laboratory of Public Health (SLPH). Kits are requested via the SLPH newborn screening supply ordering process.
out_of_hospital_midwife.submission_deadline: Blood specimen collected at 24-48 hours of age; second specimen required at 2 weeks of age (by day 14).
out_of_hospital_midwife.specimen_tracking: Results returned to the requesting provider and available through the SLPH newborn screening portal; parents receive results from their provider.

hearing_screening.program_name: North Carolina Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.out_of_hospital_path: For home/birth-center births, the midwife performs or arranges the newborn hearing screen and documents results; refusal is documented in writing in the medical record per G.S. 130A-125.
hearing_screening.statute: N.C. Gen. Stat. ÃÂÃÂ§ 130A-125 (includes hearing screening); NC EHDI 1-3-6 benchmarks

cchd_screening.out_of_hospital_performer: The attending midwife or physician performs pulse oximetry (CCHD) in the out-of-hospital setting and documents it; refusal documented in writing per G.S. 130A-125.
cchd_screening.statute: N.C. Gen. Stat. ÃÂÃÂ§ 130A-125 (critical congenital heart defect screening)

erythromycin_eye_ointment.waiver: The attending professional instills prophylactic eye treatment (silver nitrate or other approved agent); a parent may refuse, and the refusal must be documented in the medical record. North Carolina does not issue a separate stand-alone waiver form beyond documented informed refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.note: Prophylaxis applied to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum shortly after birth.

vitamin_k.note: North Carolina does not mandate vitamin K; parental choice of oral, intramuscular shot, or decline, documented in the birth record.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.note: Birth dose reported to NCIR by birthing facilities; infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers are referred for Hepatitis B case management.

gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Certified nurse midwives in North Carolina provide gestational diabetes screening/counseling in prenatal care and refer for diagnostic testing when indicated.
gestational_diabetes.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.

group_b_strep.midwife_role: Certified nurse midwives offer GBS screening in late pregnancy and arrange intrapartum prophylaxis per protocol for out-of-hospital births when indicated.
group_b_strep.note: Prenatal informed-choice item; no state newborn-screening form.
